issues.description: The README command described as verifying only ostd omits the focus flag, so it also re-checks dependency proofs instead of limiting verification to the root crate.
issues.rationale: The selected review head tells users that `cargo dv verify --targets ostd` verifies only `ostd`. In the same fixed revision, `dv` defines `-f/--focus` as “Verify root crates without re-checking dependency proofs” and passes that option to the cargo-verus focus path. Without `-f`, selecting `ostd` does not provide the documented root-only behavior. Review comment 3512718712 proposes the precise flag, the author accepts the correction in reply 3512750336, and the final approved head changes the README command to `cargo dv verify -f --targets ostd`.
